slides.title: Have you ever broken something with someone and left it broken?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Stick and Pull Foot Sweep Game
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand. The overhook player has an overhook. The underhook player has an underhook.

Overhook player: move your partner, make foot-to-foot contact, then stick the foot and pull, with your foot, your upper body, or your hands, to put him on a knee or his back. Underhook player: connect your hands, then lift him fully off the ground, get behind him, or pick up a leg.

items: The overhook player wins by putting the underhook player on a knee or his back.
The underhook player wins by lifting him, getting behind him, or picking up a leg.

body.text: Closed Guard Opening, Hands on Body
SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player has closed guard locked around the top player. The top player is inside the guard, hands on him.

Top player: hold the bottom player down, get to your feet, and press on his hips, knees, and feet to open his legs. Bottom player: keep your legs closed, using only open-hand grips on the head, wrists, and elbows.

items: The top player wins by getting to his feet and opening the guard.
The bottom player wins by stopping the top player's win for 30 seconds. Then you switch roles.

body.text: Head and Arm Strangle, Close Position Start
SLO: Finishing for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his back. The top player is in mount, one hand under his head and one under his arm. No strangle is on yet.

Top player: bring the bottom player's arm to his head and trap it there, staying under at least one elbow the whole time. Bottom player: bring the trapped elbow back to your body with nothing between it, or make the top player fall over.

items: The top player wins with the arm trapped at the head.
The bottom player wins by touching that elbow to his body, or by making the top player fall.

slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Head and Arm Strangle, Close Position Start, what wins it for the top player?

options.text: The top player wins with the arm trapped at the head.
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. Let go the instant your partner taps. Every single time. The tap is law.
You keep the pin by feeling your partner and moving with them, not by clamping down and squeezing hard. Staying calm beats forcing harder.

slides.correctText: That is how you win today.
